en.SETTINGS_LORE_INTRO_DESC: Lore pages that explain the game. Shown on launch, before the menu, until disabled.
en.SETTINGS_EF_DIAG_DESC: Check for active campaign, questions and local blocks without opening DevTools.
en.ONLINE_JOIN_DESC: Ask the host for the code; they choose the map, biome and fog.
en.ONLINE_CREATE_INFO: To create a room, pick the setup in New Game and press “🌐 Create online room”.
en.ONLINE_FOG_INFO: Per-player fog. The match starts in simultaneous turns and switches to turn-based with a clock when two factions meet.
en.ONLINE_NEED_2_PLAYERS: Share the code with another player. Each tab or window counts as a distinct player.
en.MAPS_MY_MAPS_HINT: Tap a map to play, edit or share.
en.MAPS_COMMUNITY_HINT: Maps published by the community · tap one to play, edit or share.
en.MAPS_CREATE_HINT: Create one in the editor and save it.
en.MAPS_SHARE_LINK_DESC: The link opens the map published to the community.
en.MAPS_NO_PUBLIC_URL: This copy has no public address, so a link would point to your device and only open there. It is not about your internet connection: it is the address the game is opened from.
en.MAPS_SHARE_CODE: Meanwhile you can share the code (works offline).
en.MAPS_SHARE_NOT_PUBLISHED: The link shares the map published to the community. This map is not published yet.
en.MAPS_SHORT_LINK_DESC: A short code stored in the cloud. Works for any edited map, published or not.
en.MAPS_SHORT_LINK_INFO: Works without publishing. The code is stored in the cloud and does not expose your account.
en.MAPS_SHORT_LINK_NO_CODE: This map has no valid code
en.MANUAL_MAP_DESC: Paste a code (v1:…) or a map link, including short link (?m=…); you can play it or open it in the editor.

en.EF_ALIAS_PH: What they call you on the frontier
